pages.title: YOLO11n training: live progress
pages.intro: Live view of the YOLO11n baseline runs in kernelBashing/baselines/yolo11n/runs: epoch and within-epoch progress, elapsed time and ETA, losses and validation metrics per epoch, and the report figures once a run ends. Updates are pushed by the local server as the run's files change (Server-Sent Events, polling every 5 s as a fallback). Needs the local server: python3 scripts/serve_dataset_view.py, then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/showcase.html#training.

glossary.epoch: One full pass over the training split (2700 images). An epoch ends with validation on the 300 val images, which adds one row to ultra/results.csv.
glossary.iteration / batch: One optimiser step on one batch (16 images by default): 2700 / 16 = 169 iterations per epoch.
glossary.box loss: Bounding-box regression loss (CIoU, complete intersection over union): how far predicted boxes are from the labelled boxes in position, size and shape. Lower is better.
glossary.cls loss: Classification loss (binary cross-entropy): how confident the model is that a box contains a mine (the only class, pfm1) versus background. Lower is better.
glossary.dfl loss: Distribution Focal Loss: YOLO predicts each box edge as a probability distribution over offsets; DFL sharpens that distribution around the true edge. Lower is better.
glossary.train vs val loss: Train losses are running means over the epoch's batches (with augmentation); val losses are computed on the val split after the epoch, without augmentation.
glossary.IoU: Intersection over union: overlap area of a predicted and a true box divided by their combined area (1 = identical).
glossary.precision (P): Of the boxes the model predicted, the fraction that match a real mine (IoU >= 0.5).
glossary.recall (R): Of the real mines, the fraction the model found.
glossary.mAP50: Mean average precision at IoU 0.5: area under the precision-recall curve when a prediction counts as correct at >= 50 % overlap (averaged over classes; here a single class). 0-1, higher is better.
glossary.mAP50-95: mAP averaged over IoU thresholds 0.50, 0.55, ..., 0.95, so it also rewards tight boxes. The main COCO-style score; ultralytics keeps best.pt by it.
glossary.lr: Learning rate: step size of the optimiser (AdamW here). Warm-up over the first 3 epochs, then a linear decay.
glossary.GPU memory: Apple GPU (MPS, Metal Performance Shaders) memory: the GPU_mem column of the progress bar while training, otherwise torch.mps.driver_allocated_memory at the end of each epoch (timing.json).
glossary.images / s: Training throughput: train images processed per second (iterations per second x batch size while live).
glossary.ETA: Estimated time left: rest of the current epoch (from the progress bar, or from the median epoch time) plus the remaining epochs x the median epoch time. It excludes the final best.pt validation and the report (about 1-2 min).
glossary.status: running = files changed recently (within 90 s, or 1.5 x the epoch time + 30 s, whichever is longer); finished / failed = the final status that train_yolo.py writes into timing.json and config.json; failed is also shown when nothing changed for that long and no final status was written (crashed or killed process).
glossary.SSE: Server-Sent Events: one long-lived HTTP response through which the server pushes an update whenever the run's files change (and a heartbeat every 15 s). live / polling / offline shows which transport is in use.
glossary.tqdm progress bar: The per-iteration progress line ultralytics prints to the console. train.log in the run folder does not contain it; start the server with --console-log FILE pointing at the redirected console output to get exact within-epoch progress, otherwise it is estimated from time.
